settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Rendered in Persona. Leave as the brand wordmark.

settings.label: Menu
settings.info: Nested links render always expanded, indented under their parent (up to 3 levels)

settings.label: Drawer newsletter note
settings.default: Sign up to our newsletter to receive exclusive offers.
settings.info: Shown under the newsletter form in the mobile menu drawer

settings.label: Menu text size
settings.info: The links in the desktop row (1200px and up). Above 18px the menu no longer fits on one row at 1200px.

settings.content: At the top of every page, before scrolling, the header has no background and its text is brown. On the homepage and the category pages the first section decides instead: set its 'Header text over this section' to Light when its photograph is dark enough for light text. Once the page scrolls, the header comes back on white, in brown.

settings.label: Light text colour
settings.info: Used at the top of the homepage and the category pages, over a section set to Light. Leave empty for the theme's off-white.

settings.label: Soften the photograph under the header on the homepage
settings.info: A gradient at the top of the first photograph while the header is transparent, so light type reads on a pale picture.

settings.label: Text colour at the top of other pages
settings.info: Pages that open on the page background (product, All, cart, search, pages), so pick a colour that reads on it. Leave empty for the theme's brown.
